svg.title: Machinist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as machinist, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A lathe headstock and projecting chuck hold a clearly stepped turned workpiece over the machine bed. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
